requiredFindings.title: Evidence cut-off predates the included E194 publication
requiredFindings.evidence: Git commit 1b3b815b07fdb2782f469b21f3a05f71f896c89f has both author and committer timestamps 2026-10-14T00:07:28-07:00. The board and source cutoff still say 2026-10-13 and the status directory is dated 2026-10-13-r80. E194 names that October 14 commit as accepted evidence, so the requested date/commit match does not hold in America/Los_Angeles or UTC.
requiredFindings.impact: The snapshot claims an evidence cut-off earlier than its newest accepted publication. The record is correctly scoped and pinned, but its date provenance is inaccurate.
requiredFindings.requiredCorrection: Use the actual 2026-10-14 evidence date consistently for the board cutoff, source/ledger cutoff metadata and status directory/links/subject naming, then regenerate the manifest and submit the corrected exact subject. Correct the request assertion about E194’s commit date. Preserve inherited record values, accepted U-1 bytes, validation evidence and open-gate standing; no tests or experimental rerun are needed.
